vulnerability.explanation: Divides multiple components by whiteY when (whiteY != 1) but does not guard against whiteY == 0, leading to division by zero if red.Y + green.Y + blue.Y equals 0.

asan.output:
Before normalize: whiteY=0 (expect 0), condition (whiteY != 1)=true
Caught SIGFPE (floating-point divide-by-zero) while normalizing color encoding
